lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Hi, this is Maya from Solara Health Shield. I help people find out which health plan fits them. Is now an alright time for a few quick questions?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Yes, now is a good time.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: That is great to hear. What made you look into health cover just now?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I am looking for cover for myself and my wife.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: That sounds like a sensible plan. And how old are you?
citations: web/health-shield-faq.html#"I am already covered through my employer."
web/health-shield-faq.html#Do I need a medical examination to apply?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Thanks for sharing that. Are you currently living in the Philippines?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Yes, I live in the Philippines.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: That is good to know. Just to check, are you in hospital or receiving treatment right now?
citations: web/health-shield-faq.html#"I never claim, so it is wasted money."

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: No, I am not in hospital

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: That is good to hear. Would this be just for you, or for family as well?
citations: web/health-shield-faq.html#"I am already covered through my employer."

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: That is helpful to know. Before I forget, can I take your name?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: What does the Plus Plan cover?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text:
The Plus plan provides an annual benefit limit of seven hundred fifty thousand pesos. It includes eight out-patient consultations per year and an annual physical examination.
Would you like me to go over the room and board limits for that plan as well?
